requests.title: Project status dashboard and ongoing change log
requests.note: Show roadmap progress and remaining work on the site; record new scope requests during milestone builds.

requests.title: Scoped Loot Council workspace
requests.note: Allow verified Loot Council members to manage Guild raid loot without access to Raid Mode plans, encounters, or Lodge RSVPs.

requests.title: Membership directory privacy and owner registration view
requests.note: Members control an optional owner-visible alias; the configured application owner sees signup dates and pseudonyms without emails or game data.

requests.title: Full roadmap on the status page
requests.note: Show every milestone in order with descriptions, status, specification links, expandable work and scope changes, and a next-milestone marker.

requests.title: Visible sign-out control
requests.note: Added a visible Sign out button to the authenticated topbar on desktop and mobile. The user confirmed sign-out followed by a protected-route redirect; A-03 is verified.

requests.title: Resolve Membership Worker resource-limit failure
requests.note: Investigate live Cloudflare Error 1102 on Membership, reduce avoidable CPU work, and verify the owner/non-owner privacy page after deployment.

requests.title: Required game nickname at signup
requests.note: Signup requires a game nickname with optional owner sharing. Existing accounts can edit their nickname on Your account. Fresh signup and consent acceptance remains open under A-10.

requests.title: Owner account management and usage counts
requests.note: Owner-only account management shows registered, recently seen, and suspended counts. Confirmed access changes are audited; suspension is enforced against current database state, including stale JWTs. Owner self-suspension is blocked. Hosted second-account acceptance remains open under A-08.

requests.title: Member Battle.net character onboarding
requests.note: Your account connects Battle.net and displays private available WoW characters for a selected region. Locale-aware parsing and safe failure feedback address a callback defect found during acceptance. Ownership and Guild roles remain separate. Hosted retry remains open under A-09.

requests.title: Identify accounts by login on the owner management page
requests.note: The app owner explicitly requested sign-in identities instead of member pseudonyms for account administration. Owner-only management shows sign-in email via a bounded service-only projection. Nickname sharing remains optional; signup and Membership explain owner email access.

requests.title: Show shared nickname above account login
requests.note: Owner management uses an opted-in game nickname as the main label with sign-in email underneath. Accounts without a shared nickname retain email as their main identifier. Hidden nicknames remain hidden.

requests.title: Use WoWAudit applications and boss-kill dashboard as design references
requests.note: Will wants the feel of WoWAudit's application experience and its front dashboard showing boss kills. Treat this as design direction for a later Muster/progression UX patch. No WoWAudit API connection or data import is authorized by this request. The private application page could not be inspected without access.

requests.title: Make the signed-in Main Hearth Profile a character progression dashboard
requests.note: Will provided a WoWAudit character screenshot as the Main Hearth reference. Hearth now shows Blizzard item level and optional item and boss details, player-entered Vault notes, and owner-only Raider.IO history. Upgrade tracks and crests are unavailable from this import. Will confirmed the repaired cards fill his phone screen; broader visual and accessibility acceptance remain open.

requests.title: Review private WoW-inspired Guild, wishlist, and Main profile mockups
requests.note: Will asked for research into WoW Guild sites, gear tools, and wishlists, then owner-only mockups. The private design studio presents three original sample-data concepts behind the existing server-side app-owner check. These concepts do not add real gear imports or Guild wishlist storage.

requests.title: Final integrated audit and pre-alpha acceptance
requests.note: Will requested a whole-program audit and guided live acceptance before the pre-alpha review. Claude reported no high or medium code defect. The focused retention, headers, suspension, accessibility, and documentation repairs are implemented; real-account and hosted acceptance remain open.

requests.title: Make the Hearth personal and require Battle.net proof for new Travelers
requests.note: Will approved Battle.net account-list proof for every new Traveler. Hearth is available before a Lodge, offers level 80+ characters from the connected account, adds an exclusive claim, labels old public imports unverified, and adds optional Blizzard gear and boss-kill snapshots. The claim migration is installed and the hosted build passed; private-list, duplicate-claim, visual, and accessibility acceptance remain open.

requests.title: Repair mobile Hearth width and clarify verification of older Travelers
requests.note: Will's signed-in phone screenshot exposed horizontal overflow and an unverified older Main after adding a different Battle.net character. The repair constrains mobile cards, offers Verify ownership for existing public imports, and opens a newly added alternate on its own page. Will confirmed the cards fill his phone screen and the Main verification path works. Separate-account A-09 checks remain open.

requests.title: Repair native sign-in form submission
requests.note: Will reported Forbidden after pressing Sign In. The focused referrer-policy repair preserves internal form origins and external referrer privacy while retaining cross-site request checks. Both builds and focused checks passed. Will approved direct deployment; hosted probes passed and he confirmed sign-in, refresh persistence, and sign-out. A-03 is verified again.

requests.title: Use verified Main account identity and reversible 30-day inactivity
requests.note: Will wants Main-based owner labels without emails and chose automatic restoration after 30 inactive days. The policy is specified; implementation remains pending. Disclose required owner identity sharing before onboarding and obtain acknowledgment from existing users before exposure. Preserve manual suspensions and stored data; dormancy does not reclaim storage.

requests.title: Reset unverified Travelers, add owner removal, and style content links
requests.note: The cleanup is installed, committed, pushed, and deployed. Unverified Travelers were removed while verified characters and accounts remain. Proof constraints, confirmed owner-only removal, and Lanternmere content-link buttons are implemented. Local builds and rollback fixtures passed; the connected Worker build succeeded and hosted styles returned 200. Will confirmed live removal and re-addition. Visual/keyboard acceptance remains open.

acceptance.title: Live Battle.net rank-zero claim and rank-nonzero denial
Live multi-account authorization and populated Raid Room workflows
Authenticated Worker sign-in, sign-out, and session persistence
acceptance.note: After the October 5 native form repair was deployed, Will confirmed fresh sign-in reaches his Hearth, refresh retains his session, and sign-out works. This is user-reported live evidence; the agent did not observe the authenticated browser.

acceptance.title: Fresh confirmation-email and hosted callback check
Live War Table interactions, real calendar import, and cross-account Vault consent
Live non-owner directory denial and alias opt-in/revocation
acceptance.note: Will confirmed hiding his optional alias removes it from the owner list and persists after refresh. Non-owner denial and the full opt-in path remain unverified. CR-019 specifies a replacement Main identity policy, which is not yet implemented.

acceptance.title: Signed-out protected pages, private calendar access, and Guild claim entry denial
Hosted owner account management, stale-session suspension, and restoration
Live personal Battle.net connection and private character-list visibility
acceptance.note: Will reported an add-to-Hearth redirect, confirmed the repaired phone layout and Main verification, and confirmed successful hosted Traveler removal and re-addition on October 5. Second-account character-list privacy, duplicate-claim denial, and cross-account removal denial remain unverified live.
